title: FAIRERCLIP: DEBIASING CLIP’S ZERO-SHOT PREDICTIONS USING FUNCTIONS IN RKHSS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating predictions using Equal Opportunity Difference (EOD), Worst-Group accuracy, and MaxSkew@1000 metrics across the CelebA, FairFace, and Chicago Face Database (CFD) datasets with sex as the sensitive attribute.

Calculating the MaxSkew@1000 metric on the FairFace dataset to assess the maximum imbalance of racial categories when matching images with text prompts containing various positive and negative attributes.
Measuring Worst-Group (WG) accuracy and the performance gap between average and worst-group accuracy on the Waterbirds dataset to evaluate reliance on spurious features like image backgrounds.
